## Projects
- [Aevonix 3D Controller](https://aevonix-controller.vercel.app/): Futuristic real-time 3D hardware visualizer and interactive product showcase engineered with TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL shaders, and GSAP camera choreography. Source: https://github.com/ShivamGrover-05/aevonix-controller
- [CollegesPathshala](https://collegespathshala.com/#home): Comprehensive higher education discovery and career counseling platform with degree comparison engines and automated lead routing. Built with Next.js/React, TailwindCSS, and REST APIs.
- [Vacation Visits](https://vacationvisits.in/): International luxury travel platform featuring responsive itinerary discovery, localized booking inquiries, and automated customer lead capture. Built with React and TailwindCSS.
- [Saga Holidays](https://sagaholidays.in/): Modern tour operator portal featuring glassmorphic UI, curated package filters, and instant WhatsApp inquiry dispatch.
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: End-to-end RevOps pipelines integrating custom webhooks, n8n orchestration, HubSpot CRM synchronization, and automated lead enrichment.
